posts.author: calc_this
posts.title: ok but wide boards just keep winning and I don't know why nobody talks about this more
body: Been on a long stretch of games and I keep noticing the same thing: every time I end up wide, three, four, five traits all half-online at once, I just... win more. Doesn't even feel close some nights. Meanwhile the games where I panic and commit hard to one or two lines and nothing else, those are the ones where I get run over even when the trait itself feels totally fine on its own.
And it's not only a late-game thing either, I notice it building in the midgame too, not just once someone's already snowballing out of control.

comments.author: ProbablyTilted
comments.body: Slow down, big brain. You go wide because you were already winning enough fights to AFFORD going wide. The breadth isn't doing the winning, the winning bought you the breadth.

replies.body: Sure, and normally that argument ends it for me. Except I've watched it happen in games where I wasn't clearly ahead yet either, which is the part I can't explain away that easily.
